SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.payload->'billing'->>'list_cost' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(e.payload->'billing'->>'list_cost' AS bigint) END), 0) AS list_cost_cents, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.payload->'usage'->>'input_tokens' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(e.payload->'usage'->>'input_tokens' AS bigint) END), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.payload->'usage'->>'output_tokens' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(e.payload->'usage'->>'output_tokens' AS bigint) END), 0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.payload->'usage'->>'cache_read_input_tokens' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(e.payload->'usage'->>'cache_read_input_tokens' AS bigint) END), 0) AS cache_read_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.payload->'usage'->>'cache_creation_input_tokens' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(e.payload->'usage'->>'cache_creation_input_tokens' AS bigint) END), 0) AS cache_creation_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.payload->'usage'->'server_tool_use'->>'web_search_requests' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(e.payload->'usage'->'server_tool_use'->>'web_search_requests' AS bigint) END), 0) AS web_search_requests FROM session_events e WHERE e.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND e.session_external_id = #{params.SessionExternalID} AND e.event_type = 'span.model_request_end' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
AND e.thread_external_id = #{params.ThreadExternalID}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.created_at - s.created_at)), 0)), 0) FROM session_events e JOIN session_events s ON s.workspace_uuid = e.workspace_uuid AND s.session_external_id = e.session_external_id AND s.external_id = e.payload->>'model_request_start_id' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE e.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND e.session_external_id = #{params.SessionExternalID} AND e.event_type = 'span.model_request_end' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
AND e.thread_external_id = #{params.ThreadExternalID}
